faq.1.a: Sam has built-in cleaning technology that acts on the inner surface of the bottle, so it stays fresh without manual scrubbing.
faq.2.a: The self-cleaning cycle covers everyday freshness. An occasional normal wash keeps it in perfect shape, like any bottle.
faq.2.q: Do I still need to wash it?
faq.3.a: Sam is designed for safe everyday drinking, and its cleaning cycle is made for daily use. Full materials details will be published at launch.
